articles.title: Govt mandates scrutiny of 'abnormally low bids', sets 30% threshold
articles.description: The finance ministry has made it mandatory for government agencies to scrutinise bids quoting prices more than 30 per cent below the estimated cost in a government procurements, tightening checks on abnormally low bids to safeguard service and product quality. The Department of Expenditure under the ministry has defined Abnormally Low Bids (ALBs) in government procurement, mandating scrutiny of bids falling below the prescribed threshold and seeking written clarifications wherever "concerns" arise over the bidder's ability to execute the contract at the quoted price. "A bid quoting a price more than 30 per cent below the estimated cost shall mandatorily be examined as a potentially ALB," the department said in an office memorandum. In such cases, the procuring entity would seek written clarifications from the bidder, including detailed price analyses of its bid price in relation to scope of work as given in the tender document. articles.title: Six New Vehicles for Chandrababu's Convoy at a Cost of Rs 1.78 Crore
articles.description: The Andhra Pradesh government has approved Rs. 1.78 crore to purchase six Force Urbania vehicles for Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu's security convoy. Each vehicle will cost around Rs. 29.67 lakh and will be purchased through the GeM portal. The approval comes after Chandrababu reduced his convoy from 12 vehicles to four in May to conserve fuel.

articles.title: Keralam Power Row: BJP Demands Transparency on GNA Energy Tenders
articles.description: BJP leader V. Muraleedharan has questioned Kerala CM over power purchase tenders involving GNA Energy, raising transparency concerns for stakeholders.

articles.title: AAP Plans Agitation Over Stalled Burari Road Project Construction
articles.description: AAP MLA Sanjeev Jha will lead a protest at PWD Minister Parvesh Verma's residence on November 17, demanding answers on why the Burari 100-foot road construction tender was cancelled despite earlier assurances and successful bidding.
